shared_elements: figures holding objects in raised hands
patterned garment or skirt with hem detail
row of figures along a horizontal register
justification: Both show standing, ornately dressed human figures in a horizontal row, each with headgear, patterned skirts and hands raised holding small objects, plus rosette-like discs; that combination is a fair but fairly generic ceremonial-procession scheme. The manner of depiction differs sharply: A is a bold, flat, symmetrical heraldic composition of two mirrored figures flanking a central vertical panel with masks and large sunburst disc, while B is a naturalistic, unidirectional file of similar bearded figures with no central axis or symmetry.
